name: Gaussian Depth Calculation via Ellipsoid Intersection
definition: A method to compute the depth of a 3D Gaussian along a ray by finding the intersection of the ray with the Gaussian's ellipsoid shape, specifically using the midpoint of the intersection interval.
summary: Gaussian Depth Calculation via Ellipsoid Intersection computes a numerically stable depth by finding the midpoint of a ray's intersection with a Gaussian's standard deviation ellipsoid, avoiding the instability of cubic solvers.
